In four-voice harmony (soprano, alto, tenor, bass), each voice has its own line. The rules:

1. Don't use parallel fifths or octaves.

2. Don't double the leading tone, because both voices would have to go up.

3. In a triad, usually double the root.

4. In G7, if you leave out the fifth (D), you can double the root and the resolution gets simpler.
